tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// sgrub thabs bsdus pa bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bla ma mchog dang he ru ka'i// zhabs kyi pad+mor phyag 'tshal nas// nyung zhing gsal ba'i ngag gis ni// 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs bshad// dkyil 'khor 'dir dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ bla ma las gnang ba thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ nub mo rdo rje sems dpa' bsdu ba'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal/ tho rangs ḍā ma ru'i sgra dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i sngags su grags pas gnyid bslangs nas/ he ru ka'i skur langs la snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du bltas nas/ spro na dbang gi skabs ltar khrus bya'o// de nas stan bde ba la kha lho phyogs su bltas te 'dug la/ bdud rtsi ri lu myangs nas/ rang he ru ka yab yum du bsgom zhing*/ shrī he ru ka a ha zhes brjod pas/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te// he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid// ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste// ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o// de'i don dang ldan pa bdag yin snyam du bsgoms pa'i snying gi nang du/ a rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i zla ba dag pa 'jig rten pa dang thun mong ba'i ye shes kyi steng du gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i sems hūm̐ du dmigs pa'i ye shes lnga'i ngo bor bsgoms pa las 'od zer sngon po/ ljang gu/ dmar po/ ser po rnams zhal bzhi nas rim pa bzhin 'phros pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang bas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral ba dang*/ bde ba bla na med pa dang mi 'bral ba dang*/ chags sdang med cing 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad snyoms par gyur pa'i tshad med pa bzhi rim pa bzhin bsgom zhing*/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mdzub mo phyogs bcur bskor nas se gol brdabs pa dang*/

su khe bha wan+tu/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// yang hūm̐ las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros pas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs nas/ sems can thams cad he ru kar bsgom ste/ rang gi gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shes pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug 'du byed rdo rje rgyal po/ rnam par shes pa rdo rje sems dpa'/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu gyur pa dpal he ru ka mig gti mug rdo rje/ rna ba zhe sdang rdo rje/ sna ser sna rdo rje/ kha 'dod chags rdo rje/ lus phrag dog rdo rje/ skye mched thams cad dbang phyug rdo rje/ sa'i khams ltung bar byed ma/ chu'i khams gsod par byed ma/ me yi khams 'gugs par byed ma/ rlung gi khams gar gyi dbang phyug nam mkha'i khams pad+ma'i drwa ba can du gyur par bsam mo// yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ steng gi char rang gi bla ma/ rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa la/ bla ma brgyud pa thams cad kyis bskor ba 'og gi char 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs pa la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥs bla ma dang*/ na ma shrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa la bh+yaḥs/ dkyil 'khor la phyag byas nas/ phyi dang blos sprul pas mchod la/ sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// 'khor lo sdom pa'i dam tshig kun// gzung zhing yongs su bskyang bar bgyi// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la// zab mo'i chos ni ston pa dang*// rtag tu bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam gyi mchog /rim pa gnyis la gnas par bgyi// dge bas bdag gzhan ma lus pa// he ru ka dpal thob par shog

/ces lan gsum brjod pa dang*/ tshogs kyi zhing rnams kyis/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi gnas pa 'di ni legs par gnas pa yin gyis/ gnas pa 'dis gnas na mchog gi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro// zhes gnang ba byin pa la slar yang mchod nas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol lo// de nas oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod nas/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las shar du khwa gdong ma dang*/ steng du khaṇ+ḍa ro hā dang*/ oṃ grih+na grih+na huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang du 'ug gdong*/ oṃ grih+nā pa ya grih+nā pa ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub tu khyi gdong dang*/ 'og tu khaṇ+ḍa ro hā dang*/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga bān/ badz+ra rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lhor phag gdong*/ de bzhin du shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma/ lho nub tu pho nya ma/ nub byang du mche ba ma/ byang shar du 'joms ma rnams rim pa bzhin du spros pas/ bgegs thams cad bskrad par bsam mo// yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ mda'i drwa ba dang*/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba rnams su gyur par bsam/ yang g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub phyogs bcur bskor zhing se gol brdab pa dang*/ oṃ me di nī badz+ri bha wa ban+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra prā kā ra hūm̐ bam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañja ra hūm̐ yam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūm̐ kham̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la tram̐ sam̐ tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la a na lārka hūm̐ ram̐ hūm̐/ zhes re re'ang lan gsum gsum brjod pa dang*/ rim pa bzhin sbyar zhing srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom mo// yang hūm̐ las rdo rje phur bu dang*/ rdo rje tho ba'i tshogs spros pas/ pho nya rnams kyi lag pa g.yon pa dang*/ g.yas su gtad pa nyid sprul du ma dang bcas pas/ phyogs skyong rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i bgegs rnams bkug nas/ dkar po'i phyogs rnams lam la bkod/ nag po'i phyogs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab par bsgom zhing*/

oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭā na phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra kī la ya/ badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā pa ya ti/ sarba bigh+nān kā ya wā k+tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa dang tho bas brdungs par bsgom zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra muṅka ra badz+ra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas lus thal bar brlags nas/ rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas par bsgom zhing*/ pho nya rnams rdo rje rwa ba'i kha khyer la 'khod nas sgrub pa po sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du bsrung bar bsam mo// de nas chos thams cad sems tsam dang*/ de'ang rang bzhin med par bsams nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas phyi nang gi chos thams cad stong par bsam pa ni/ rgyu tshogs gnyis bsag pa'o// stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam ljang gu/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po/ bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po/ lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po/ sum̐ las ri rab/ shar shel/ byang gser/ nub pad+ma rā ga lho bai ḍūr+ya las grub pa/ gru bzhi/ bang rim bzhi/ lcog brgyad dang ldan pa rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar/ pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i snying por/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bor/ ā li phrag gnyis las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes su bsgoms pa'i steng du/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ ya la ḍa ḍha da dha dang bcas pa'i kā li phrag gnyis las/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su bsams pa'i bar du/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ dkar po bsgom/ nyi ma'i steng du lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ yum gyi mkha' dang*/ yab kyi byang chub kyi sems dang*/

sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i ngo bo/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ zla ba dang*/ hūm̐ rnams brtsegs pa bsgoms la/ oṃ nas brtsams te mas yar rim gyis hūm̐ gi bar du thim zhing*/ hūm̐ yang nā da'i bar du thim nas/ nā da dmar skya shin tu phra zhing ljid pa/ dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i sngags sgrogs bzhin pa/ 'khyog cing myur du babs pa ni sgra yin la/ des nyi ma phug nas/ tshul hūm̐ la thim nas thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du cig char gyur pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so// de rim gyis gsal gdab ste/ ri rab kyi steng srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ nang nas nag po/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang gu'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po'i kha khyer dang*/ de'i steng du mda' yab las zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang dril bu g.yer ka dang bcas pa'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ mda' yab kyi steng du rin po che'i drwa ba seng ma'i pu shus bskor ba/ phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa'i lha mo bcu drug gnas pa/ bris pa ltar glo 'bur du gyur pa'i sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor/ ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du/ pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang ri dwags dang gdugs dang ldan pa/ gzhan yang rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can dang*/ rin po che dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ gos dang 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par mdzes par byas pa'i nang gi lha snam/ shar sngo/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser ba'i dbus su/ mchod rten bang rim bzhi pa lta bu'i 'khor lo rim pa bzhi pa'i lte bar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad par bsam mo// gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du/

shar du gtum drag byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ lhor 'jigs su rung ba/ shar lhor nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa/ lho nub tu mun pa mi bzad pa/ nub byang du ki li ki li'i sgra sgrogs pa/ byang shar du ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod rnams su/ rim pa de nyid kyis brgya byin/ gnod sbyin/ chu lha/ gshin rje/ me lha/ srin po/ rlung lha dbang ldan te phyogs skyong ba dang*/ de bzhin du shi ri sha/ a shwat+tha/ aṃ ko la/ tsu ta/ ka rañja/ la ta pa ra ka ti/ pa ra ti pa tā/ bha ṭa ste shing chen po brgyad dang*/ de rnams la brten pa'i sgo mtshams ma rnams kyi gzugs 'dzin pa'i drag gtum la sogs pa'i zhing skyong brgyad dang*/ nor rgyas/ 'jog po/ stobs kyi rgyu/ pad+ma/ hu lun+ta/ rigs ldan/ dung skyong*/ pad+ma chen po ste klu brgyad dang*/ sgra grag pa/ rmugs pa/ mun pa can/ kun du 'khyil pa/ gang ba/ 'bab pa/ drag po/ 'khrigs pa ste/ sprin chen po brgyad dang*/ gzhan yang chu chen po brgyad/ me chen po brgyad/ mchod rten chen po brgyad gnas shing*/ sprul pa dang rang rgyud pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ grub pa dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ 'dre dang*/ srin po dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ sha za dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ ce spyang la sogs pas yongs su gang ba'i dur khrod kyis bskor ba'o// nang gi pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i steng du/ rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngo/ g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing*/ 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i ko rlon gos su gyon pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pas ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pas dgra sta/ lnga pas gri gug drug pas mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga

bzhi pas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pas rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pas tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mgo bltabs nas mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs bcings pa'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yon na tshes gcig gi zla ba dang*/ mtshog ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ 'khor lo/ rna cha/ mgul rgyan/ gdu bu/ ska rags/ thal chen gyi rgya ste/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa// dgod pa drag shul 'jigs su rung*// snying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste// gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa'o// de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs bcur bsdigs pa/ spyan gsum pa gcer bu skra grol ba mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan cing*/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'khril ba'o// snang ba dang*/ thabs dang*/ lhag mthong dang*/ snying rje chen po'i ngo bo ni yab yin la/ stong pa dang*/ shes rab dang*/ zhi gnas dang*/ bde ba chen po'i ngo bo ni yum yin zhing*/ zung du 'jug pa'i phyir kun tu kha sbyor ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo// pad+ma'i shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du lā mā ljang gu/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍā ro hā dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis kyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang*/

kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa'o// mtshams bzhir ye shes kyi chus gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du/ bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa gnas te/ bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo gri gug gi rwa ba dang*/ ka ba dang*/ gdung dang*/ thog phubs can/ rdo rje phyed pa'i tog gis mdzes par byas pa'o// de'i phyi rol du thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i shar rtsibs pul+lī ra mā la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā li dang rab tu gtum mo/ byang dzā lan+dha rar ma hā kaṃ kā la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub au ḍ+yan du kaṃ kā la dang 'od ldan ma/ lho arbu dar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ shar lho go dā wa rīr su rā bai ri dang*/ brtan pa'i blo can ma/ lho nub rā me shwa rir 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub byang de wī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar mā la war rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste/ thugs kyi 'khor lo kha dog sngon po/ nam mkha' la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs shing sa bla sbyong ba/ rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ ka ba dang*/ gdung dang*/ thog phubs dang bcas pa'o// de'i phyi rol tu gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i shar rtsibs kā ma rū par aṃ gu ri dang ai rā wa tī/ byang o trer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thungs ma/ shar lho ka liṅgar rab tu bzang po dang sh+yā ma de wī/ lho nub lam+bā kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ nub byang kāñcir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ byang shar hi mā la yar mig mi bzang dang kha gā na na ste/ gsung gi 'khor lo kha dog dmar po sa la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs shing*/ sa steng sbyong ba pad+ma'i rwa ba dang*/ ka ba dang*/ gdung dang*/ thog phubs dang bcas pa'o// de'i phyi rol du sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i shar rtsibs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/

byang gṛ ha dang de war rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hā/ nub sau rāṣ+ṭar rta mgrin dang shauṇ+ḍi nī/ lho su war+ṇa dwī par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lho na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ lho nub sin+dhur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ nub byang ma ror rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma/ byang shar ku lu tār rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ sku'i 'khor lo kha dog dkar po/ sa 'og na spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs shing sa 'og sbyong ba/ 'khor lo'i rwa ba dang*/ ka ba dang*/ gdung dang*/ thog phubs dang bcas pa'o// dpa' bo rnams zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa'o// gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang g.yon gyi gnyis par ka pā la 'dzin zhes bla ma 'ga' zhig gsung ngo*// rgyan dang cha lugs he ru ka dang mtshungs pa'o// rnal 'byor ma rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag mtshan dang*/ cha lugs rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs shing*/ gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba la brtson pa'o// de'i phyi rol dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i shar sgor khwa gdong ma/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma/ lho sgor phag gdong ma rnams phyogs kyi mdog can/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma/ g.yas sngo g.yon ser/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma/ g.yas ser g.yon dmar/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma/ g.yas dmar g.yon ljang*/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma/ g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ yi dwags kyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ drag mo'i gzugs can phyag mtshan dang cha lugs snying po'i rnal 'byor ma lta bu ste/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dpral bar rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'o// lha snam gyi grwa rnams su bcud sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa brgyad dang ldan zhing*/

sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rwa ba dang*/ ka ba dang*/ gdung dang*/ thog phubs dang bcas pa snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom mo// de nas bdag gi blo la snang ba pho nya sngags skyes kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid 'dzam bu'i gling na bzhugs pa'i pho nya zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor nyid yin la/ de nyid 'og min gyi pho nya lhan skyes longs sku'i dkyil 'khor yin zhing*/ de nyid chos kyi sku las gzhan ma yin zhing*/ pho nya gsum gcig tu bsres nas/ yang bdag gi blo la snang ba'i lha sum cu so bdun po 'di nyid/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun gyi ngo bo yin la/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun po 'di nyid kyang*/ lha sum cu so bdun gyi ngo bor rnam par dag pa'o zhes dag pa dran par bya ba ni phyi'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'o// de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa de dag la gsal bar dmigs pa'i mthus/ 'og rlung dang ltag pa'i rlung g.yos pas/ spyi gtsug gi ham̐ dang*/ lte ba'i a/ sgra dang tshul snying gar 'dres pa'i rkyen gyis lus kyi dkyil 'khor cig char bskyed nas/ rim gyis gsal gdab ste/ spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsib logs rdo rje'i rwa ba/ pags pa rdo rje'i gur dang rwa ba bla re/ ba spu mda'i drwa ba/ skra sen ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung 'khor dang*/ rkang mthil rlung*/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying ga nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu bas sgo bzhi/ mig la sogs pa gzhal yas khang gi rgyan/ rkang rnams ka ba'i tshogs te/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ snying gi nang gi hūm̐ nyid dpal he ru ka yab yum dang bcas pa sngar bshad pa bzhin gsal gdab bo// he ru ka'i phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas kyi dang po la mam̐ mkha' 'gro ma/

gnyis par lam̐ lā mā/ g.yon gyi dang por pam̐ khaṇ+ḍa ro hā/ gnyis par tām̐ gzugs can ma/ phyag lhag ma brgyad la hūm̐ ring po brgyad kyi/ g.yas kyi bzhi/ khwa gdong*/ 'ug gdong*/ khyi gdong*/ phag gdong ma dang*/ g.yon gyi bzhi gshin rje brtan ma/ pho nya ma/ mche ba ma/ 'joms ma rnams dang*/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhir/ pu dzā o a go rā de mā kā o tri ko ka la kā hi pre gri sau su nā si ma ku/ khams dang bcas pa rnams dpa' bo dang*/ dpa' mo rnams su gyur pa ni/ spyi bo pul+līr mā la ya ra khaṇ+ḍa ka pā li dang rab tu gtum mo/ spyi gtsug dzā lan+dha rar ma hā kaṃ kā la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna ba g.yas pa au ḍ+yan du kaṃ kā la dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag pa arbu dār mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma ste gnas/ rna ba g.yon pa go dā wa rīr su ra bai rī dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ smin ma'i dbus rā me shwa rir 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis de wī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang laṃ ka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis mā la war rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas/ thugs kyi 'khor lo kha dog sngon po nam mkha' la spyod pa'o// mchan khung gnyis kā ma rū par aṃ gu ri dang ai ra ba tī/ nu ma gnyis o ṭer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing*/ lte ba tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sna rtse ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thungs ma ste nye ba'i zhing*/ kha ka liṅgar rab tu bzang po dang sh+yā ma de wī/ mgrin pa laṃ pā kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo ste tshan+do ha/ snying kāñcir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ 'dom par hi mā la yar mig mi bzang dang kha gā na na ste nye ba'i tshan+do ha rnams gsung gi 'khor lo kha dog dmar po sa la spyod pa'o// mtshan ma pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/

bshang lam gṛ ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hā ste 'du ba/ brla gnyis sau rāṣ+ṭar rta mgrin dang shauṇ+ḍi nī/ byin pa gnyis su war+ṇa dwī par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba/ sor mo bcu drug na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong gnyis sin+dhur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma ste dur khrod/ mthe bong bzhi ma ror rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis ku lu tār rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste nye ba'i dur khrod rnams sku'i 'khor lo kha dog dkar po sa 'og na spyod pa'o// lha de rnams yi tshul gong du bshad pa bzhin gsal btab la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ zhes brjod cing*/ bdag gis bsgoms pa'i phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor 'dzam bu'i gling na bzhugs pa'i sprul sku/ 'og min na bzhugs pa'i longs sku rnams dbyer med par gyur nas/ gnyis su med pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag yin snyam du dran pa lan gsum byas la/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā badz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa bdag yin snyam du bsam mo// de nas gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la/ snying gar oṃ ha rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ mgo bor na ma hi rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis bau ṣa ṭa he dpal he ru ka nag po/ mig gnyis su hūm̐ hūm̐ ho rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ rta mchog ljang gu ste dpa' bo'i go cha dang*/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ gshin rje ma sngon mo/ khar hriṃ mam̐ rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ mgo la hreṃ hriṃ skyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ skrag byed ma ljang gu/

yan lag rnams la phaṭa phaṭa tsaṇ+ḍi ka dud kha ste dpa' mo'i go cha bkod la/ yab kyi gnas su yum dang*// yum gyi gnas su yab gnyis su med par bsams te/ yi ge'i rnam pa nyid lha'i ngo bor bsgom pa ni go cha dgod pa'o// de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su bskor zhing*/ phaiṃ zhes brjod cing snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba/ mdun du spyan drangs la snga ma ltar mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod pas rang la bstims nas/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam pa ni ye shes pa gzhug pa'o// yang dbang gi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang khro mo dang*/ mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs pa la snga ma bzhin mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur nas/ bkra shis kyi glu dang*/ bgegs bskrad pa dang*/ mchod pa mdzad pas ye shes kyi chus lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma spyi bor lud pas/ bde ba chen po'i lha lnga dang*/ dam tshig gi lha rnams la rdo rje sems dpa'/ thugs kyi 'khor lo la mi bskyod pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo la 'od dpag med/ sku'i 'khor lo la rnam par snang mdzad du gyur par bsam pa ni/ rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab pa ste/ rgyas par bsgom pa'i tshul lo// //skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/

sems bskyed pa dang*/ dga' ba gsum sngon du song nas/ srung ba'i 'khor lo rdzogs par bsgoms la/ spyi bor bla ma'i chag gnyis sam/ bla ma dngos dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin du bsgom pa la/ mos pa drag po byas pas lus la thim pa'i rkyen gyis/ nang gi sgra tshul 'dres pas lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal gdab par byas pa man chad snga ma ltar bsgom pa ni 'bring gi tshul lo// sngon du srung ba'i 'khor lo yang mi bsgom zhing*/ nang gi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa 'ba' zhig lam du byed pa'i phyir/ go cha bcing ba man chad kyang mi byed par/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal btab nas/ sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs/ de nyid la yid mnyam par 'jog pa ni bsdus pa'i tshul te/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa'o// de nas lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las/ las kyi kha dog dang mthun pa'i sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas/ yab kyi zhal dang*/ yum gyi zhal dang*/ bha ga dang*/ rdo rje'i lam nas 'khor ba dang*/ rnal 'byor ma bcu gnyis kyi ni thugs ka'i sa bon la g.yon du 'khor la/ de dag las kyang phyi rol du 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba ra swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ hrī ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa gang mos pa bzla ba ni bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor te bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// //rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par 'dod pas rang gi lte bar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i snying por zla ba'i steng du/ rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje snyems ma dang gnyis su med pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ bsam pa las/ 'od 'phros pas gtso bo nas rim pas dkyil 'khor dang*/ snod bcud gsal btab pa la dmigs pa gtad pas/

thams cad 'dar zhing g.yo bar bsgoms nas/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pa thams cad rim gyis phyi'i he ru ka'i bar du thim zhing*/ de'i yang yum yab dang*/ yab kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bsdus nas/ de'ang lte ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ de'i yang yum yab dang*/ yab kyang thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang*/ de'ang rim gyis thig le la thim zhing*/ thig le'ang mthar yal bar bsgoms nas/ mi dmigs pa'i ngang la blo bzhag pa ni rdo rje sems dpa' bsdu ba'o// yang rang gi lte bar pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi par shar nas g.yon skor gyis/ sa rlung*/ chu rlung*/ me rlung*/ rlung rlung gi rang bzhin la ser po/ wa dkar po/ ra dmar po/ ya ljang gu dang*/ dbus su nam mkha'i rlung gi rang bzhin/ thig le sngon po rnams dmigs nas/ dbugs phyir rgyu ba'i tshe/ la las 'od zer skud pa 'bring po'i tshad tsam/ sna bug g.yon nas mdun du thad kar sor bcu drug gi bar du byung zhing*/ nang du 'jug pa'i tshe la nyid la slar thim par bsams nas rlung kha sbyor bya'o// de ltar rtag tu bsgoms pas du ba lta bu'i rtags mthong ba'i tshe la wa la bstims nas/ wa las 'od dkar po ldang 'jug la sogs pa snga ma ltar bsgoms pas smig rgyu lta bu'i rtags 'byung ngo*// de'i tshe wa ra la bstims nas/ 'od dmar po'i ldang 'jug la sogs pa bsgoms pas/ me khyer lta bu'i rtags 'byung ngo*// de'i tshe ra ya la bstims nas/ 'od ljang gu'i ldang 'jug la sogs pa bsgoms pas mar me lta bu'i rtags 'byung ngo*// de nas ya dbus kyi thig le la bstims nas/ 'od dang ldang 'jug mi bsgom par thig le nyid la yid gtad de/ rlung kha sbyor bsgoms pas nam mkha' sprin med lta bu'i rtags 'byung la/ de'i mthar mthong ba'i lam gyi ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro// yi ge bsdu ba'o// yi ge de dag gi dod du thig le la dmigs nas/ snga ma ltar bsgom pa ni thig le bsdu ba ste rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// mnyam par gzhag pa'o// de nas stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rang he ru ka yab yum gyi skur dmigs pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/

nang dang phyi'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ snod bcud thams cad gsal bar dmigs nas/ bdag gi so dang sen mo la sogs pa'i khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni khaṇ+ḍa ka pā li la sogs pa dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ngo bor rnam par dag cing*/ de dag gi rten mi phyed ma la sogs pa'i rtsa rnams ni rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ngo bor rnam par dag go zhes bsam zhing*/ dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i sngags brjod pas kyang brtan par bya ba ni/ khams dang rtsa'i dag pa dang*/ yab kyi rtsa sngags kyis rus pa'i rgyan dag rigs drug gi ngo bo dpal he ru ka dang*/ oṃ ha la sogs pas 'khor lo la sogs pa'i rgyan drug dpa' bo drug dang*/ yum gyi rtsa sngags kyis mgrin pa'i phreng ba rdo rje phag mo dang*/ yab kyi snying pos mi mgo'i do shal dang*/ nye snying gis rna rgyan dang*/ yum gyi snying pos glang po dang stag gi pags pa dang*/ oṃ bam̐ la sogs pas ska rags dpa' mo drug dang*/ gtso mo'i snying po la sogs pa dpa' mo sum cu rtsa bdun gyi sngags kyis phyag mtshan dang*/ mtshams bzhi'i thod pa dang yum gyi nye snying gis mi mgo'i dbu rgyan rnams sngags dang lha de dag gi ngo bor dran par bya zhing*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni lha yi sku// shes rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra// nyin mo bcom ldan rdo rje can// rnal 'byor ma ni mtshan mor bshad// ces dag pa dran par byas nas/ dpa' bo dang*/ dpa' mo dang go cha chen pos bsrungs la/ sum+bha ni'i sngags lan gnyis kyis phyogs mtshams bcings te/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha'i dkyil 'khor/ brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags/ sems kyi rtog pa thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du bsgoms nas/ yab kyi rkang pa brgyad pa brjod pas byin gyis brlabs la/ yul rnams la sdang zhen med par longs spyod pa ni spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro// de nas mngon par bshams pa'i gtor ma sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par bsams pa'i ngang las/

yaṃ las rlung dang*/ ram̐ las me'i steng du/ āḥlas thod pa yangs par/ a las zla ba'i steng du shar nas g.yas skor dang dbus su/ go ku/ da/ ha/ na las/ ba lang*/ khyi/ rta/ glang po che/ mi'i sha dang*/ de'i steng du/ bi/ mu/ shu/ ma/ ra las/ dri chen/ dri chu/ byang chub kyi sems/ sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ rak+ta/ de'i steng du/ hūm̐/ bh+rūm̐/ ām̐/ dz+rām̐/ kham̐ las chos kyi dbyings/ me long lta bu/ mnyam pa nyid/ so sor rtog pa/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes su bsams pa'i steng du/ oṃ dkar po mgo thur du lta ba/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i steng na hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ 'od zer 'og tu 'phros nas rlung g.yos shing me sbar bas/ rdzas rnams bzhu zhing bskol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas bskul nas/ oṃ dang zla ba dang sna tshogs rdo rje las bdud rtsi babs shing*/ 'od zer rlangs pa dang bcas pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba dang oṃ dang bcas pa rnams gtor ma la thim pas/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ ha ho hrīḥs byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor dmigs la/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dur khrod brgyad kyang yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor brgyad du gyur pa/ ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas pa'i lha rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung ba'i lam nas gsol bar bsam zhing rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki nī sa mā ya s+t+waṃ dri sh+ya hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lha'am 'khor lo'i grangs dang mnyam pa dang*/ dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i phreng sngags kyis phul nas phyi nang yid las byung bas mchod la/

rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod de/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la yi ge brgya pa brjod cing*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol nas/ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs su gsol la/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o// 'jig rten pa la ni mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor mas dbul lo// gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro// kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang he ru kar dmigs pa'i lte bar gtum mo'i me 'bar bas lus yongs su gang ba'i khrod na/ snying gar dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang*/ nang gi gtso bo'i rigs bdag tu bla ma bzhugs shing*/ lto bar dur khrod na gnas pa'i lha rnams dang*/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad gnas par bsams la/ lag pa'i mchod pas lag pa'i lha mchod nas/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs/ kha hom khung*/ kha zas bsreg rdzas su dmigs te shin tu zhen par mi bya zhing ro phyin par zos nas/ lhag ma oṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hās lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la sbyin no// kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro// //de ltar rnal 'byor bzhi yan lag dang bcas pa la goms pa las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin spros bcas dang*/ spros med dang*/ shin tu spros med kyis brtan par byas pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes skyes pa dang*/ gzhan gyi don du kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa spyad pas byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu gnyis bgrod de nye ba'i rgyus mtshams sbyar nas/ rang dang gzhan gyi don lhun gyis grub pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro// gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni zhar las 'byung ba nyid do// 'di yang rang gi slob ma mchog /ji big de mur gyis bskul nas// 'phags pas sbyar ba'i dge ba yis// 'gro kun he ru kar gyur cig /slob dpon lū hi pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs 'di ni/ 'phags pas lcags mo lug gi la/ོ
smin drug zla ba'i tshes nyi shu lnga'i nyin par shing kun gyi mkhar du nyung zhing gsal ba'i tshig gis rnam par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
